attackers_goals: Manipulate SSM operations to take control over EC2 instances and strengthen the foothold in the cloud environment of the organization, by running critical operating system commands, manipulating the parameters store, and patch management configuration.
description: A cloud identity performed an SSM operation for the first time.
investigative_actions: Check the identity's role designation in the organization. Verify that the identity did not perform any sensitive SSM operation that it shouldn't.
name: Unusual AWS systems manager activity
